description: Manage runtime feature-gate flags stored in .gossip/runtime-flags.json. Actions: list (show all flags + source), get (one flag), set (write flag), unset (remove flag), reload (discard cache after hand-edit).

key.description: Flag key (required for get, set, unset). Must start with GOSSIP_.

reason.description: Reason for change, appended to audit log (required for set, unset).

name: gossip_config
